title: Fix exponential retry delays
prompt: Fix retryDelay in src/retry.js. Attempts are one-based: attempt 1 returns baseMs, attempt 2 returns baseMs * 2, and so on, capped at maxMs. A non-finite argument or attempt below 1 returns 0. Truncate fractional attempts down. Treat negative baseMs and maxMs as 0. Keep the existing export and defaults. Run a few focused checks if useful.
